app.name: Nexus Remote
cli.about: Secure, real-time remote control for your own devices
cli.identity.missing: No device identity exists yet. Run `nexus id create` first.
cli.identity.exists: A device identity already exists. Refusing to overwrite it.
cli.identity.confirm_delete: This permanently destroys this device's identity; all pairings become invalid. Re-run with --yes to confirm.
cli.doctor.title: Nexus Remote environment check
cli.agent.unreachable: Cannot reach the Nexus agent ({reason}). Is `nexus-agent` running?
cli.status.name: Name
cli.devices.empty: No paired devices yet. Run `nexus pair offer` on one device and `nexus pair join` on the other.
cli.pair.offer_code:
On your other device run:

    nexus pair join "{code}"

The code works once and expires in 5 minutes.
cli.pair.compare: Compare these four words with the other device's screen:
cli.pair.confirm: Are the words identical on BOTH screens? [y/N]
cli.pair.auto_warning: WARNING: --assume-words-match skips the human check that detects a man-in-the-middle. Use it only for testing.
cli.unpair.ok: Removed {name}. It can no longer reach or see this device.
cli.device_ambiguous: `{query}` matches more than one device; use the full ID.
cli.ping.title: Diagnostics for {name}
cli.lockdown.on: Lockdown is ON: every remote access request is refused.
cli.agent.stopping: The agent was asked to stop.
cli.remote.open_failed: Could not open a session to {name}
cli.screenshot.timeout: The device did not send a picture in time.
cli.files.truncated: (listing cut off; the folder has more entries)
cli.files.need_remote: Exactly one side must be on a device, written as DEVICE:PATH
cli.consent.waiting: Waiting for access requests. Press Ctrl-C to stop.
cli.consent.prompt: {name} ({fingerprint}) wants to use this device: {grants}.\nAllow? [y]es once / [a]lways / [n]o (auto-deny in {secs}s):
cli.consent.remembered: Allowed, and {name} will not be asked again.
cli.consent.expired: That request has already been answered or timed out.
cli.trust.unattended_on: {name} can now use this device without asking.
cli.trust.unattended_off: {name} will be asked about first from now on.
cli.power.confirm: {action} {name}? This will end your connection. Type the device name to confirm:
cli.wake.sent: Wake-on-LAN packets sent for {name}. It can take up to a minute to start.
cli.shell.hint: Connected to {name}. Press Ctrl-] then . to detach (a named shell keeps running), or Ctrl-] then k to end it.
cli.forward.listening: Forwarding 127.0.0.1:{local} to {remote} on {name}. Press Ctrl-C to stop.
cli.forward.bad_spec: Write the forward as [LOCAL_PORT:]HOST:PORT, for example 5432 or 8080:localhost:80.
cli.audit.none: There is no audit log yet: the agent has not run on this device.
cli.audit.ok: Audit log intact: {records} records, signed head {head}.
cli.update.disabled: Updates are not configured. Set update.manifest_url and update.public_keys in the config file.
cli.update.not_yet: Version {version} exists but is still rolling out ({percent}% of devices so far).
cli.update.no_artifact: Version {version} has no build for this computer yet.
cli.update.replaced: Replaced {path}; the previous version is kept as {old}. Restart the agent to use it.
cli.update.manual: Run the installer yourself (it may need administrator rights): {command}
